sources.title: Linden Platform Engineer — fictional role
sources.body: Own backend platform services, distributed systems reliability and database migration safety. Explain operational tradeoffs and incident ownership.

sources.title: Linden interview process — fictional employer evidence
sources.body: Recruiter screens discuss background and motivation. Actual technical rounds and dates are confirmed separately by invitation. No questions are guaranteed.

events.subject: Application received: Linden Platform Engineer
events.body: We received your application to Linden Platform Engineer. No interview is scheduled.

events.subject: Confirmed recruiter screen
events.body: Your 30-minute recruiter screen with Alex Rivera is confirmed for November 12, 2026 at 10:00 America/New_York. Discuss your background, systems ownership and interest in the platform team.

I finished the recruiter screen. They focused on systems ownership. I struggled to explain my database migration tradeoffs. The recruiter said the next round would cover distributed systems, but nothing is scheduled yet.

events.subject: Confirmed distributed systems round
events.body: Your 60-minute technical round with Jordan Lee is confirmed for November 17, 2026 at 14:00 America/New_York. We will discuss distributed systems, service reliability and database migration tradeoffs.

events.subject: Meeting link updated; interview time unchanged
events.body: Use https://meet.example.test/linden-technical-updated for your November 17 technical round. Time, interviewer and format are unchanged.

events.subject: Application update
events.body: We will not proceed with your application. Your November 17 technical interview is cancelled.
